display.purpose: The couple's names in the hero, stacked, ivory. Frank Ruhl Libre.

display-latin.purpose: The couple's names when the invitation is in English, and the small Latin names line (1.45rem, gold) in Hebrew. UnifrakturCook.

headline.purpose: Section headings in gold. Weight 800 in Hebrew, 600 in English.

title.purpose: Long date, venue name, footer names, confirmation title; times step up to 2.3rem.

body.purpose: Reading text and form controls. David Libre.

label.purpose: Time labels and hints in mute. No uppercase, no tracking.

numeral.purpose: The hero date only. Pirata One, LTR isolated.

admin-body.purpose: All dashboard text. System UI sans.

admin-title.purpose: Dashboard page title; section titles at 1.0625rem / 650.

shadows.name: choice-selected
shadows.purpose: Doubles the gold border of a selected RSVP choice. The invitation's only box-shadow.

shadows.name: ground-glow
shadows.purpose: The single warm glow behind the heart. A background, not a shadow; the only gradient.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Stem drawing, rose bloom in the choice socket, plate press.

motion.name: orn-draw
motion.purpose: Stems draw themselves once on arrival (stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0).

motion.name: orn-bloom
motion.purpose: Leaves, thorns, roses, and details fade in after the stems. Plays once.

motion.name: gate-rose
motion.purpose: The gate rose fills with wine when the guest attends.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Border and background changes on fields, choices, plates.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing animates; the engraving appears complete.

components.name: Plate
components.description: The invitation's one primary action: the gate RSVP plate or the form submit.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gold); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-wine); color: var(--color-ivory); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-plate:hover { background: var(--color-wine-bright); } .ds-plate:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Answered Plate
components.description: The gate plate after the guest has replied: quiet, ground-filled, offers to change the answer.
components.css: .ds-plate-quiet { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gold); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-ground); color: var(--color-ivory); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-plate-quiet:hover { background: var(--color-plate-2); } .ds-plate-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Secondary actions and links: language switch, map links, change answer.
components.css: .ds-text-button { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem; color: var(--color-gold); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1.1875rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-button:hover { color: var(--color-ivory); } .ds-text-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text inputs and textareas in the RSVP form.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gold-dim); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-plate); color: var(--color-ivory); caret-color: var(--color-gold); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1.1875rem; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #a99f8f; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--color-gold); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--color-gold); background: var(--color-plate-2); }

components.name: RSVP Choice
components.description: Radio rows for attending / declined. Selected is a doubled gold line, never wine. Attending blooms a generated rose in the socket; declined shows an ivory dot (shown here).
components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; min-height: 4rem; padding: 0.6rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gold-dim); background: var(--color-plate); color: var(--color-ivory); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: var(--color-gold); } .ds-choice.ds-is-on { background: var(--color-plate-2); border-color: var(--color-gold); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-gold); } .ds-choice-mark { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1.9rem; height: 1.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gold-dim); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-choice.ds-is-on .ds-choice-mark { border-color: var(--color-ivory); } .ds-choice.ds-is-on .ds-choice-mark::after { content: ''; width: 0.8rem; height: 0.8rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-ivory); }

narrative.overview:
The invitation is a gilded line engraving on black: a heart of thorns above, a pointed iron gate below that holds the guest's answer. Everything decorative is drawn in antique-gold line, generated as SVG from seeded code, and it draws itself once on arrival (stems first, then leaves and roses fade in) and then holds still. Lettering is ivory; roses and the one primary plate are burgundy; the crescent is moon-white.

It is stationery, not an interface: a single centred column on a flat near-black ground, square corners, hairline rules, no cards, no glow. It refuses the dark wedding template (names in a thin gold rectangle, countdown, pill button).

A second, deliberately plain system serves the admin dashboard: system UI font, dark neutral panels, small radii, gold only as the primary-action accent. The two systems never mix.
keyCharacteristics: Gold is line; burgundy is fill; ivory is lettering.
One column (max 30rem), phone-first, Hebrew RTL first with English LTR.
Ornament is generated vector, drawn once, then still.
Square corners and hairlines on the invitation; rounded quiet panels only in admin.

rules.name: The Line-Work Rule
rules.body: Gold is stroke, never a filled surface on the invitation. (Solid gold appears only as tiny ornament ink: thorns, finials, sparkles.)

rules.name: The One Wine Rule
rules.body: Burgundy fills roses and the primary plate. A selected state is never wine.

rules.name: The Single Glow Rule
rules.body: One warm radial glow sits behind the heart. Every other surface is flat; no other gradients.

rules.name: The Joined Vav Rule
rules.body: In Hebrew, "and" is the vav joined to the second name on its own line; a lone vav never stands as a separate element. English shows a small gold "and" between the names.

rules.name: The Blackletter Ration Rule
rules.body: Blackletter is Latin only: the couple's Latin names and the hero date numerals. Never Hebrew, never body copy, never admin.

rules.name: The Braid Rule
rules.body: The braided two-strand ring and braided rule are the only Norse element. No runes, knot panels, or other Viking motifs.

rules.name: The Generated Ornament Rule
rules.body: Ornament is SVG generated in code from a fixed seed, styled only through the `o-*` class vocabulary (line, hair, ink, gap, leaf, rose, moon, star; `o-draw` and `o-bloom` for arrival). Never raster, never emoji, never an icon font.

dos: Do draw every decorative element as gold line on ground, using the existing generators and `o-*` classes.
Do keep burgundy to roses and the single primary plate.
Do mark selection with the doubled gold line and `plate-2`.
Do keep invitation corners square and borders at 1px.
Do join the Hebrew vav to the second name.
Do keep body text at 1.1875rem or larger and touch targets at 2.75rem or larger.
Do let the engraving draw once, then hold still; honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep admin in the system font with neutral panels, gold only on the primary action.
donts: Don't fill a surface with gold on the invitation, or use wine for a selected state.
Don't add cards, shadows, glows, or gradients; the one ground glow behind the heart is the only one.
Don't add Norse motifs beyond the braided ring and rule.
Don't use raster ornament, emoji, or icon fonts.
Don't set Hebrew, body copy, or admin text in blackletter.
Don't round invitation controls or bring invitation ornament and display faces into admin.
Don't loop or replay ornament motion.
